subject.title: fix(auth): cooldown inline api key billing failures

question: Should OpenClaw accept provider-scoped fail-closed cooldowns for inline `models.providers.<id>.apiKey` credentials once the accidental public SDK helper export is removed?
rationale: The behavior fixes a real auth-provider outage mode but changes upgrade/runtime behavior for existing inline-key users and introduces persistent provider-level usage state, which is a maintainer compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept after API-surface repair
options.body: Repair the accidental SDK callable export, then proceed with the provider-level cooldown behavior as the intended auth-provider fix.

options.title: Require an opt-in or recovery surface
options.body: Preserve existing inline-key behavior by default and require an explicit strict mode, doctor reset, or other recovery UX before fail-closed cooldowns affect upgrades.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Close or pause this branch if maintainers do not want provider-level inline-key cooldown state in core runtime.

recommendation.title: Accept after API-surface repair
recommendation.body: Repair the accidental SDK callable export, then proceed with the provider-level cooldown behavior as the intended auth-provider fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The local history points to Peter Steinberger as the recent owner of the public SDK barrel and adjacent auth/provider surfaces involved in the compatibility choice.
